spirit:component.spirit:name: eagle4_drafter
spirit:component.spirit:description: EAGLE4 drafter — PDI#10 D1/D2 registered-read COMBREAD fix. D1_LAT=1 -> stage_io_buffer G6 activation seam registered read (RD_LAT=1) + scaled-GEMV-array weight/enable WLAT=1 compensation, killing the body GEMV W[c]*act[c-1] off-by-1 (project_pdi10_d1d2_gemv_act_seam_stale). D2 (rmsnorm_block + residual_add RDATA_LAT=1) hardwired in the top: registered x/gamma/a_save_buf reads align the sumsq/apply/add engines, killing the rmsnorm and R3/R7 residual stale-by-1. Every fix is an EXPLICIT always_ff flop (sim==silicon even under LUTRAM downgrade). Carries WO-051 per-KV-stack local combine + WO-053 KV-BRAM shed + G8 splice + SCALED Q3.13 K_PAR=16 GEMV + SLR_SAFE seams + G8 BALANCED-TREE selector (G8_OPT1C_TIMING: log2(K_C) comparator tree, exact, zero-drop). Layout B, URAM 1,710 (88.83%), 88 MHz DERATE (G8 selector closes; body closes 100).
